description_en: Enables the Global Accelerator (GA) service for an office network
description_zh: 为办公网络开通全球加速
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-office-site-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-shanghai+dir-2593820000 --name testGA --resource-group-id rg-3mtuc28rx95lx0000 --accelerate-region IpVersion=IPv4 IspType=BGP Bandwidth=50 AccelerateRegionId=ap-southeast-1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOfficeSiteAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The name of the GA instance
parameters.name: name

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the acceleration region
element_fields.name: accelerate_region_id

element_fields.help_en:
The IP protocol version used to access the GA instance.

Only standard pay-as-you-go GA instances support `DUAL_STACK`
element_fields.help_zh:
接入全球加速服务的IP地址协议。

`DUAL_STACK`类型仅标准型按量计费的全球加速实例支持
element_fields.name: ip_version

element_fields.help_en: The bandwidth allocated to the acceleration region. Unit: Mbps
element_fields.help_zh: 加速地域分配的带宽。单位：Mbps
element_fields.name: bandwidth

element_fields.help_en:
The line type.

This parameter is required for pay-by-data-transfer GA instances.

The supported line types vary by acceleration region
element_fields.help_zh:
加速地域公网线路类型。

带宽计费方式为按流量的全球加速实例需要配置该项。
加速地域不同，支持的加速地域公网线路类型也不同
element_fields.name: isp_type

parameters.help_en: A list of regions where access points provide acceleration
parameters.help_zh: 要加速的上车点地域信息列表
parameters.name: accelerate_region
